Messages.Author: Fredrik Ljungberg
Messages.Body:
>(Golconda, another Fame, Secure Haven, Banishment, and Reality would
also >work, BTW)

Golconda might not work on a small vamp. Don't forget that if he get's
torporised and you worry about the pool cost of that he might be
fetched-torporised again, you can always eat him up if you won't get
burned in the blood hunt. Or have someone else eat him. Or play
vulnerability.

When your famed vamp is about to be rushed, check if your allies has a
means of helping you out. (eagles sight, Anneke or whatever)
